featured_reviews.name: Samira Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Used Car Buying Experience at Auto Empire Andheri East Marol
I am extremely delighted with my experience at Auto Empire having purchased two cars from them over the past year. Their professionalism, honesty, and customer service have been outstanding, making them my go-to dealership for luxury and premium vehicles.

First Purchase: Toyota Innova Crysta (Ramazan 2024)

Last year, during the holy month of Ramazan, I was looking for a Toyota Innova Crysta and after scouting multiple dealerships, I found that Auto Empire offered the best deal. The car was in immaculate condition, priced competitively, and the entire transaction was smooth and transparent. From documentation to delivery, they ensured a hassle-free experience.

Second Purchase: Creta Sx Auto Diesel (March 2025) Ramzan

Having had such a great experience the first time, I didn’t think twice before returning to Auto Empire for my next purchase. This time, I was looking for a Creta Sx Auto and once again, they provided me with the best price and the most genuine deal. The car was delivered in pristine condition, reflecting their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

Why I Highly Recommend Auto Empire

✅ Best Prices in the Market: I compared multiple dealerships before making my purchase, and both times, Auto Empire offered the lowest price without compromising on quality.

✅ Genuine & Trustworthy Dealers: The two brothers running the business are incredibly polite, knowledgeable, and transparent in their dealings. They don’t just sell cars—they help you make the right decision.

✅ Segregated Car Collections: They maintain a well-organized inventory with only top-quality cars, ensuring customers get the best options.

✅ Neat & Clean Car Delivery Experience: Both of my purchases were delivered in spotless condition, with all necessary paperwork and servicing done beforehand.

✅ Smooth & Hassle-Free Process: From financing and documentation to post-sale service, they take care of everything, making the entire experience seamless.

Final Verdict: 110% Recommended!

If you are looking for a genuine, honest, and customer-friendly dealership, I highly recommend Auto Empire Their service, pricing, and attention to detail set them apart from the rest. Whether you're looking for a luxury car or a premium used vehicle, this is the place to go.

⭐ Rating: 10/10 – One of the best used car-buying experiences I’ve ever had!

featured_reviews.name: Re Think
featured_reviews.review_text:
To Mr. Farhan Saudager and the Management,

I approached your dealership with genuine interest and respect, expecting professionalism and transparency. While the initial interaction was satisfactory, I was surprised and disappointed by the tone and manner in which I was later addressed — dismissive, bordering on sarcasm, as if my presence were a burden rather than valued. What’s more concerning is the inconsistency in the information shared. I was told the vehicle had been sold, yet it continues to be listed across your official catalog and social media platforms. This raises questions about the integrity of your communication. Unfortunately, I am now seeing that similar experiences have been echoed by others in reviews as well. I come from a place where respect, courtesy, and professionalism are not just expected — they are a way of life. My intention was never to escalate matters, but if any false information is attributed to me, or if my character is misrepresented in any way, I will address it through proper and professional channels. I hope this is taken as constructive feedback, not hostility. One must always remember — how you treat people speaks louder than what you sell.

featured_reviews.name: swapnil gawde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very glad to share the experience I had with the dealer of AutoXchange for buying Honda City. Please allow me to elaborate my experience for buying my car. Earlier I was using SX4 2007 model which I bought from direct owner. It took me almost 3 months to finalize that car, as I was not able to find the cars in good condition. Due to aging of car (15 years), I decided to upgrade the car.
This time I preferred to buy new automatic car rather than going for pre-owned cars based on my past experience (time consuming task). Then I went to multiple showrooms and took test drive of multiple cars and finalized Honda city which suited all my requirements, but the model which I was looking for was out of my budget. Hence, I opted for pre-owned car again, but I struggled to find the direct owner. Lastly, I was left with only option of dealer, which I was not comfortable with.
I started by hunting visiting various dealers in Vashi, Chembur, but the condition of cars were not up the mark. Then, I went to AutoXchange dealer at Andheri and met proprietor Mr. Ashwin Lulla. He personally showed me the condition of Honda city and trust me, the car was in well maintained condition with historical records of service center, which I was looking for. While having to look across the car, I came across office staff also, who were also very professional in their work, which is very rare to see. The office is also well organized with neat and clean washrooms.
I was really shocked to see the nature of dealer, who was very straight forward and equally transparent, he was not really selling the car, but patiently shown us the car, which is very rare to find in dealers. I was really impressed by his nature and also working culture of his office.
Hence, looking at all the above aspects, I finally got the deal, after only a little bit of bargaining as the price offered was less compared to other dealers/websites and also condition of car is very well maintained. The dealer also helped me to get the funds transfer on same day along with my address change in Aadhar card, as I had taken delivery on same day. This shows that the dealer is technically sound in all areas.
In my case, there was a slight correction in RC book, which was noticed later on, and the dealer took the whole ownership of getting it done at his own cost. He also guided me properly to take the right insurance. This shows the genuinity of the dealer and the trust he keeps with the customers after the delivery also.
Thank You so much Mr Ashwin Lulla !!
Very much Happy with the deal !!
End of my search for pre-owned cars !!
Tip: Before looking at cars quality, dealers quality should also be assessed.

featured_reviews.name: viral patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
It has come to my attention that this company has been dishonest in their business practices by selling faulty vehicles.

I purchased a car from them and paid a deposit of 300 lakh with the expectation that the car would be delivered in perfect mechanical condition. Additionally, I paid for the tires separately. The total amount I paid for the car was 790,000.

To my dismay, the car broke down after only driving 290 kilometers due to a catastrophic transmission failure. It is important to note that I had only owned the car for a mere 18 hours. I immediately contacted the owners to address this issue.

I must emphasize that Ashish Merchant, one of the owners, displayed a complete disregard for customer satisfaction and prioritized his own financial gain. It is disheartening to realize that he was willing to deliver the car in such a condition, even a week before when I was in Mumbai with my 5-year-old son. Imagine being stranded on the highway with a failed transmission, with a young child in tow.

In light of these circumstances, I have taken the necessary steps to lodge fraud charges against this company. I firmly believe that they should refund all the money I invested, including the additional 10,000 I paid to reach my destination.

It is my understanding that this business operates by deceiving customers with false promises and hospitality, only to take their money and provide them with unsafe vehicles. I strongly advise avoiding this establishment to prevent any further inconvenience or financial loss.

Please note that my intention is to alert others about my negative experience and to seek a resolution to this matter.

Now they have broken car and money i hope justice system works in India and shutdown fraudsters.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Acharya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to provide feedback regarding my recent vehicle acquisition from Dream And Drive in November 2025.
I purchased a Toyota Camry from them, and I am pleased to report that the overall experience was highly satisfactory. The transaction proceeded smoothly, and I found my interactions with Mr. Lucky to be professional and efficient throughout the purchasing process.
I would like to acknowledge the exemplary conduct of Mr. Lucky and his colleagues, all of whom demonstrated commendable professionalism, courtesy, and a genuine dedication to customer service. Their helpful and respectful approach contributed significantly to the positive nature of this experience.
However, I must note that there are currently three outstanding matters that require resolution. Mr. Lucky has assured me that these issues will be addressed in due course. I intend to provide a comprehensive follow-up assessment approximately one month from now to document the resolution of these pending concerns.
I trust that these matters will be handled with the same level of professionalism demonstrated during the initial purchase process.

Update on my review:

I am writing to provide a further update regarding my experience with the vehicle I acquired from Dream And Drive. I am pleased to report that Luckybhai has honored all commitments made during the transaction. As promised, the broken tail light was replaced yesterday. Additionally, and notably, both number plates were replaced during this service visit—a gesture of modest monetary value but one that I greatly appreciate.
I would also like to document an incident that occurred following my purchase. On the day after taking delivery of the vehicle, I transported it to a facility for accessory installation. Upon collection, I observed multiple warning indicators on the dashboard, including: (a) Headlight System Warning, (b) ABS Warning, (c) Traction Control Warning, (d) Hybrid Battery Warning, and (e) Engine Oil Warning. Understandably concerned, I immediately arranged an inspection at Toyota and contacted Luckybhai, as I feared the vehicle might have underlying defects.
Throughout this situation, Luckybhai provided consistent reassurance and support. He facilitated communication with Mazharbhai, who confirmed that the vehicle was mechanically sound and pledged their assistance in resolving the matter. It was subsequently determined that all warning signals had been triggered by water ingress into the sensors during the window film installation process. I have since driven the vehicle to Pune, and it performs excellently.
In conclusion, the after-sales support provided by Luckybhai has exceeded my expectations and has been a most pleasant surprise. I extend my sincere appreciation to Luckybhai and his team.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Customer has to be aware. As this was my first car I assumed and trusted True Value will not hide anything from me. All 4 speakers were rusted completely and did not work. I made a mistake of not checking the same this at the time of buying. Sales executive will not tell you anything at the time of buying as regards to which parts are working and which are not. If you are buying for the first time my advice is take with you someone who has knowledge and shall help in checking each and everything about the car. Because I had to then change the speakers at my expense. If I had checked it before hand I would have negotiated and decreased the Purchase price. My point is let the customer know what are the issues with the car before hand. And after buying they will say that this is covered and this is not covered etc etc in warranty. They will make you cry and run as you have paid them and the car is delivered.
My advice : Withhold some amount, use the car for some days and if some issues arise get them rectified. I made some mistakes and have learnt them. Hopefully this will help other buyers.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Wadkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let me tell you a story of the best car dealer for used cars in Mumbai. One line won’t be enough to describe how amazing their service is. We were looking for a car to but recently when we came across Car Giant, their hospitality and honesty while selling the car was really good. We had our doubts before buying the car but Rajmeet Sir(Owner/Dealer) made sure to tick everything from our checklist, they gave us the car not only for test drive but also to get it checked from Maruti Suzukis service center, after the car was checked he also allowed to get the inspection done at the service center once we had finalised the car they also provided free car service as the last service in the car was done a year ago.
We got the delivery and everything I thought everything is done but after a month in our parking area a rat got into the car messing up and breaking the wiring which caused lots of damage to the car as the car was fully automatic the check engine light had came on the dash and many electrical functions stopped working (ideal start stop, quick shifting, avg fuel economy bar status, cruise control etc.) the rpm started fluctuating, car was not shifting the gear until it reached 6-7k rpm and it had lost the pick up leading to extra fuel consumption. I had no idea what needed to be done and I was ready to take the car to the Maruti service center but before that I called Rajmeet Sir(Car Dealer) once I told him about the issues his words were “Rohit sir car leke aa jao kal dekh lenge kyaa issues hai” I was kind of relieved after that as no dealer would ever entertain any customer after they have bought the car, but Rajmeet sir took the car and tested it gave it to their mechanic who fixed the wiring in 2 days and the car was running normally like it should, every electrical function that had stopped due to the wiring….started working again.
They also gave me this rat spray to apply it while the car is in parking.

To sum up if you’re thinking to get a used car do it from CAR GIANT!!!
